recognize_zh: A 圖前臂與手背多顆潰瘍、結痂的大型腫瘤；B 圖軀幹多發紫紅色結節，部分中央潰瘍；C 圖存活曲線顯示大細胞轉化組（虛線）存活較差，整體指向蕈狀肉芽腫大細胞轉化（large cell transformation）。
features: Panel A: multiple large ulcerated, crusted, fungating tumors on the forearm and dorsum of hand
Panel B: numerous violaceous dome-shaped nodules on the trunk, some with central ulceration
Panel C: Kaplan-Meier overall survival curve comparing no transformation (solid) versus large-cell transformation (dashed)
Survival curve for transformation plateaus near 30-40% versus ~40% longer-term for non-transformed cases, with earlier drop in the transformed group
Clinical photographs and a graph; no histology shown
describe_en: Composite figure. Panels A and B are clinical photographs showing multiple ulcerated and fungating tumors on the forearm and hand and numerous violaceous nodules, several centrally ulcerated, on the anterior trunk. Panel C is a Kaplan-Meier plot of overall survival in years, in which patients with large-cell transformation (dashed line) show an earlier and steeper decline in survival than those without transformation (solid line). The clinical picture of rapidly enlarging, ulcerating tumors is consistent with transformed mycosis fungoides; the diagnosis itself requires biopsy demonstrating large cells comprising more than 25% of the infiltrate.

ddx.dx: Primary cutaneous anaplastic large cell lymphoma
ddx.vs: C-ALCL lacks a prior history of patch/plaque MF and usually shows localized nodules; transformed MF may also be CD30+, so clinical history is the key discriminator.
LyP produces recurrent, self-healing papulonodules that regress within weeks, unlike the persistent enlarging tumors seen here.

ddx.dx: Cutaneous involvement by systemic peripheral T-cell lymphoma
ddx.vs: Systemic PTCL shows nodal/visceral disease at presentation on staging, whereas transformed MF evolves from long-standing skin-limited disease.

captions: A: Ulcerated tumors on forearm and hand; B: ulcerated violaceous nodules on trunk; C: overall survival by large-cell transformation status
